messages:
alex: Seeing steady heap growth on longchat sessions that use tool calls + streaming. Starts small and ramps over ~30–90 minutes. Not an OOM, just slow memory creep.
priya: can you paste the repro command and the main heap snapshot?
alex: repro: `./run_longchat_test --model rdx-3b-q --tokens 120000 --concurrency 6 --enable-toolloop`
alex: attached quick stats from one run: heap +120MB over 45m, KV resident pages increase, RSS goes from 2.1G -> 2.35G.
alex: pprof top (heap.alloc_objects):
```
# 100MB  kv_slot_object
# 45MB   kv_pagechain
# 12MB   string (prompt cache)
```
jordan: hm kv_slot_object high. any logs showing eviction events?
alex: eviction logs show frequent candidates but low success. snippets: `evict_candidate=0x7f.. age=235s size=64kb pinned=false` then `evict_attempt -> failed (refcount>0)` a lot.
kevin: Did we change the eviction heuristic recently? I remember we raised min_age from 60s -> 120s in the batching perf PR.
priya: right — batching PR 2024-02 bumped `min_kv_age_s`. That reduced churn but could let dead entries live longer. Could be compounding on long contexts.
alex: interesting. Also saw this after kernel-selection change (2.3.1) — possibly different alignment + allocator touch pattern increased fragmentation so small free spans can't be coalesced.
jordan: can you share slab/arena stats?
alex: arena stats: `small_free=18MB, small_used=400MB, large_free=10MB, large_used=1.4GB` fragmentation index ~ 0.12.
priya: not huge fragmentation but combined with lots of pinned refs maybe the pages aren't reusable. Any pattern in last_access?
alex: yes: tail of entries (older prefixes) have last_access ~30m ago but refcounts remain 1 because toolloop hold handles until session end.
kevin: that sounds like handle lifetime semantics are the culprit — longchat toolloop keeps references to ephemeral KV handles which prevents eviction. Could be a leak in client code or our handle release path.
priya: can you grep for `kv_handle_acquire` vs `kv_handle_release` in that run?
alex: quick grep: acquires: 182, releases: 180 (two mismatches). Not huge but repeated across sessions leads to accumulation.
jordan: Are there other places where we store handles in closures for streaming callbacks? I recall a reporter bug where stream callbacks closed over the handle.
priya: good call — check `streaming/async_tools.py` patch from March.
kevin: to isolate: try adding a forced `kv_release_idle(age_s=30)` background job and rerun. If growth stops, it's handle retention.
alex: ran forced eviction test: growth slowed but didn't stop. Heap delta reduced from +120MB -> +30MB. So handle retention explains part, fragmentation another.
priya: what about KV page residency policy? We have prefix caching TTL 24h for some customers — are those flags enabled in test?
alex: TTL is default 3600s in repro. Not long.
ordan: what about kernel selection path? Could it interact by changing allocation alignment leading to small unusable holes?
kevin: plausible — the new memcpy-kernel uses aligned mmaps which create more 64k-aligned slabs. If our slab coalescer expects 4k boundaries, coalescing fails. Need allocator trace.
priya: next steps plan: 1) add instrumentation to count unreleased handles per session and tag by stack trace; 2) add allocator trace when slab coalesce fails; 3) run longchat with forced `kv_release_idle` and with old kernel-selector toggled; 4) implement short-term mitigations (lower min_kv_age, aggressive background compaction).
alex: I've already added a temporary metric: `kv.unreleased_handles{session}` and a small tracer to capture the top-3 callsites holding handles. Posting artifact: https://perf.redwood/attic/1719801234 (tracebot also uploaded flamegraphs).
tracebot: artifact uploaded: https://perf.redwood/attic/1719801234/flame.svg :eyes:
priya: thanks. can someone take a look at `streaming/async_tools.py` for captured handles? I'll do a quick pass.
jordan: I'll add allocator logging in the dev runtime build and run overnight. Will also flip kernel-selector to previous commit to check delta.
kevin: if we confirm allocator alignment regression, we should add unit tests for slab coalescing with different alignment assumptions.
alex: FYI, quick mitigation patch: decrement `min_kv_age_s` back to 60 for long-context feature flags and enable `kv_background_compact=1`. I'll push a canary after review.
priya: +1 for canary. monitor `kv.unreleased_handles`, `kv.evictions.succeeded`, `mem.rss` per-session.
alex: creating a small dashboard and will drop into #observability once it's live. thanks y'all :thumbsup:
kevin: great. Update here with results of kernel toggle and the allocator logs.
priya: and we'll file a follow-up to add a regression test in CI that runs a 30m longchat simulation and asserts no >40MB/session growth.
alex: opened ticket INF-2247.
priya: ok locking this to eng-runtime for now.
